method: Compared every polygon ring after rounding coordinates to 8 decimal places; all exterior and interior rings must match. This is exact geometry deduplication, not a physical-building census.

osm_spatial_match_audit.caveat: Spatial joins are not exact source-ID joins. Multiple components may be repeated zoom/style geometry, building parts, or imperfect spatial matches; do not automatically collapse them solely by OSM ID.

render_height_audit.handling: Preserve each source component and its height until the source LOD/zoom semantics are resolved; do not silently choose one height.

next_required_checks: Inspect exact duplicate component groups and source zoom/style origin.
Review distinct geometries mapped to the same OSM ID.
Separate physical buildings from building parts and LOD duplicates.
Only then publish a final unique-building count.
